findings.evidence: `isJordanDomain_of_convex` at lines 164–165 explicitly requires `IsOpen s`, while `isJordanDomain_interior_of_convex` at lines 145–146 concludes the property only for `interior s`.
findings.fix: Say “elliptical disk,” “interior of a convex polygon,” and “bounded open intersection of open half-planes,” or explicitly apply the interior theorem. Make the same correction to the module examples at line 27 and the Basic module pointer at line 54.
findings.issue: The docstring says an ellipse, convex polygon, or any bounded intersection of half-planes “is a Jordan domain,” but `IsJordanDomain` requires openness; an ellipse commonly denotes only its boundary, and polygons or intersections of closed half-planes are generally closed.

summary: Several theorem docstrings narrate proofs, and the examples documentation inaccurately treats polygons, ellipses, and arbitrary bounded half-plane intersections as domains without taking interiors or requiring openness.
